# Bradley Rowan
 
> Fractional technical search advisor: causal SEO experimentation, AI search defence and technical migration governance for large-catalogue platforms. Previously Head of SEO at Rome2Rio, with experience at Viator, SEEK and Envato. Based in Sydney, working asynchronously one day a week.
 
## Site
 
- [Home](https://bradleyrowan.com/): Services, selected results and how to get in touch
 
## Services
 
- Causal search A/B experimentation: statistical split-testing frameworks that show SEO ROI before full rollout
- AI search and zero-click defence: assessing generative search risk and protecting brand visibility
- Technical migration governance: risk-managed migrations for platforms of 1M+ pages
